### Unity and Humility
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-october-22-2012.html
Passage: Psalm 133:1
Points:
- Unity and humility are inseparable companions; neither can survive without the other.
- When pride takes over, harmony among believers rapidly deteriorates.
- Fighting and quarreling reflect worldly patterns that fail to bring glory to God.
- Enduring friendships are formed by refusing to engage in conflict.
- Believers are urged to act as peacemakers and grant others freedom to grow.

### The Priceless Gift of Christian Unity
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-priceless-gift-of-christian-unity
Passage: Psalm 133:1-3
Points:
- Harmony among Christian ministers is an excessive, undeserved gift to the wider church.
- Unity represents what is morally good in God's eyes and delightful for His people.
- The imagery of overflowing anointing oil highlights how deeply precious this fellowship is.
- Like dew descending on Mount Zion, spiritual unity reflects God's life-giving presence.
- Biblical oneness does not mean identical personal preferences, but embracing Christ's humble servant mindset.
